content.text: All preferred elements appear satisfied. Submitting a compliant finding without a redline.

input.quote: 14.1 As between the Parties, Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material, and intellectual property Customer owned or developed independently of the Services. No right transfers to Vendor except the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position in full. 14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data and independently developed IP and limits Vendor's rights to processing solely to provide, secure, support and improve the Services for Customer (service delivery, not independent exploitation); 15.1 reinforces this and any other use requires our express written consent, so there is no standing Vendor licence. 14.2 vests ownership of each Deliverable in Customer on creation with an express Vendor assignment of all worldwide right, title and interest plus personnel assignments. 14.3 preserves Vendor Technology only, and 13.2 grants us and our Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to embedded Vendor Technology with modification and contractor-support rights. 14.4 rules out joint ownership absent a signed instrument. The only sub-preferred detail is that Deliverable ownership in 14.2 is "subject to payment of the applicable Fees" — noted, not a deviation, and no redline is warranted.

mappings.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
mappings.quote: Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer

mappings.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
mappings.quote: Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.

mappings.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
mappings.quote: For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence

mappings.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
mappings.quote: Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence

mappings.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
mappings.quote: perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.

mappings.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
mappings.quote: As between the Parties, Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material, and intellectual property Customer owned or developed independently of the Services.

mappings.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
mappings.quote: No right transfers to Vendor except the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer.

mappings.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
mappings.quote: No jointly owned intellectual property is created unless the Parties sign a separate instrument identifying it and their exploitation rights.
